summary: Full ASP.NET Core CaneFactory backend regression run on a FRESH SQLite DB. 53/53 tests passed covering: forced first-login password change + 403 gate, RBAC boundary (Operator vs Developer), refresh-token rotation + revoke-on-reuse-all-sessions, wrong-password lockout after 5 attempts, masters (Zone id=1, Village id=101, case-insensitive/trimmed duplicate, IFSC validation, Bank duplicate name+branch, Party DUPLICATE name+mobile block), grower code 101/1 & 101/2 sequencing, Aadhaar duplicate block + masking, mobile duplicate 422 requiresConfirmation + acceptDuplicateWarning bypass, bank account masking on lookup, rate versioning + overlap 409 + current-rate lookup, RS232 parser positive/negative/malformed frames (String Type 15), weighment gross below-minimum 409 BELOW_MINIMUM, gross success with server-side 250.50 Quintal + purchase id=1 + idempotency 409, tare tare>=gross 409, tare success with EXACT 2dp math (net 167.09, cutting 3.34, tax 1.67, final 162.08, amount 51865.60 @ rate 320), pending-tare listing, second-tare 409, for-tare-after-done 409, purchase list/lock-blocks-tare/unlock/cancel-without-reason 400/cancel-with-reason 200, audit log contains Login+GrossWeighment+TareWeighment, weight-rules PUT, camera password never returned (hasPassword flag only), SMS API key never returned (hasApiKey flag only), user-guide role-scoped, dashboard/health, unauthenticated /api/purchases 401.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthController rate limit (10/min/IP on /api/auth/*) collides with the 5-failed-attempt lockout under real client load — a legit user retrying 6+ times gets a 429 that masks the actual 423 lockout signal (had to sleep 65s in tests to observe the lockout path). Consider excluding successful logins from the counter or raising the rate window so both the lockout UX and the rate-limit UX can be observed distinctly.

GrowersController.SoftWarningsAsync includes name+father+village match as a warning but the endpoint contract only advertises 'mobile duplicate' — worth documenting the second trigger in API_DOCUMENTATION.md so mobile UI shows the right message.

Camera GET returns HasPassword (PascalCase) via anonymous type serialization — Flutter/JSON convention expects camelCase; verify System.Text.Json options are consistently set (test relied on both cases).

PartiesController stores `Email` requirement as optional but returns 400 (not 422) when missing IFSC on bank — inconsistent 4xx choices across masters (Bank invalid IFSC = 400 while village duplicate = 409). Standardise: validation failures = 422, business/duplicate conflicts = 409, permission = 403.
WeightRuleConfig PUT requires the client to round-trip every boolean flag; a partial-update DTO (PATCH-style) would prevent accidental disable of ApplyToGross/ApplyToTare from a stale form.

Audit response exposes IP + device UA but does not scrub JWT/token fragments if a caller ever writes them into oldValue/newValue — add a sanitizer in AuditService for any string that looks like a Bearer token.
test_credentials: developer / Dev@2026Temp (fresh DB, forces change) → change to DevSecure@2026. Operator: testop1 / OpSecure@2026 (may be locked after test 53).
seed_data_creation: Fresh DB creates seed via app startup. Test suite adds: Zone id=1 (TEST Zone A), Village id=101 (TEST Village A), Bank id=1 SBIN0001234, Party TEST Party X, Growers 101/1..101/3, Rate for VarietyTypeId=1 @320.00, Purchases 1 (TARE_DONE) & 2 (CANCELLED) & 3 (GROSS_DONE by operator), Camera #1, SMS provider TEST, user testop1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite is order-sensitive; run with `pytest -n 0` (see /app/backend/pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2). Reset DB via: kill dotnet PID listening on 8001, rm /tmp/canefactory_dev.db*, then restart per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Full run takes ~70s (65s sleep for /api/auth rate-limit reset before lockout test). After the suite, testop1 will be lockout-flagged — reset the DB before rerunning if you need testop1 unlocked.
rca of the issue: No production issues found. Initial test run showed 32 failures purely due to wrong request-payload field names in the tests (main agent's controllers use ZoneName/VillageName/GrowerName/growerCode etc., not the generic 'name' I initially guessed). Fixed by reading /app/CaneFactorySystem/backend/src/CaneFactory.API/Controllers/*.cs and Domain entities to derive exact DTO field names. Rate-limit false-positive on the lockout test (attempts hit 429 instead of 401) was mitigated by inserting a 65-second cool-off before the wrong-password loop.
